name: Mayor
ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
designRole: Alternative good victory at three alive with no execution; possible death redirection complicates attacks.
explanation: Alternative good victory at three alive with no execution; possible death redirection complicates attacks.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, good wins.
The Mayor may choose to stop the riot. If they do so when only 1 Riot is alive, good wins. Otherwise, evil wins.
